links.comparator_used: Human evaluators independently assessing the same responses (expert review of every output)
links.outcome: Agreement between LLM self-assessment with a four-tier rubric and human grading of response correctness
links.effect: LLM self-assessed 89% of responses as correct (scores 1-2) vs 67% by human evaluators (chi-square, P < 0.0001); greatest discrepancy in the partially correct category; 80 scenarios
links.tradeoff: Systematic AI self-overestimation of correctness, so the automated judge was not a reliable substitute for expert oversight
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o-mini self-assessed 89% of responses as correct (scores 1-2), compared to 67% by human evaluators (chi-square, P < 0.0001), with the greatest discrepancy in the partially correct category.

design_hint: LLM self-evaluation vs human expert review of outputs
